sections.h2: Where is West Valley City, Utah?
sections.html:
West Valley City is an inner suburb on the northwest side of the Salt Lake Valley, in Salt Lake County, and it is the second most populous city in Utah. Salt Lake City borders it to the north, South Salt Lake to the east, Magna to the west, and Taylorsville and Kearns to the south.

The Oquirrh Mountains are to the west and the Jordan River forms the eastern edge. Elevation is about 4,304 feet and the city covers roughly 35.5 to 35.9 square miles, depending on which source you read.

The 2020 census counted 140,230 residents, up 8.3% from 129,480 in 2010. The Census Bureau's July 2025 estimate shown on this page is 137,491, which is slightly below the 2020 count.

sections.h2: How was West Valley City formed?
sections.html:
West Valley City incorporated in 1980 by merging four unincorporated communities: Hunter, Granger, Chesterfield and Redwood. The land west of the Jordan River was first staked out by Joseph Harker and his family, and Granger was settled in 1849 by Welsh pioneers who came with Dan Jones.

Hunter was settled in 1876 and began irrigating in 1881, with fruit trees as the main crop. Growth took off in the 1970s, and the city had 72,299 people at its first census in 1980.

West Valley City hosted men's and women's ice hockey for the 2002 Olympic Winter Games. In 2011 it began planning a downtown district around Fairbourne Station, with a civic center, hotels, a plaza and a transit hub.

The city has no single housing style. The next section breaks down the main areas.

sections.h2: What are the main areas of West Valley City, and what houses are in them?
sections.html:
West Valley City is usually described in four areas, and the age of the houses differs among them. These descriptions come from 2013 neighborhood data, so incomes and populations have since changed.

  • East (Redwood, Chesterfield and East Granger): mostly brick ranch houses from the 1960s and 1970s, near Valley Fair Mall and the Maverik Center. The Westshire area south of the mall has 160 mid-century modern homes built in the 1960s and 1970s by architect Ron Molen.
  • Central (West Granger and Hunter south of 3100 South, with Lakepark and Westlake Business Park to the north): includes the planned Highbury development in the northwest portion.
  • West (West Hunter, Woodhaven and Oquirrh): mostly planned developments from the 1990s and 2000s.

Median household income in 2013 was reported as $42,512 in the East, $55,087 in the Central area and $64,356 in the West. A seller in the East is often selling a 50 or 60 year old brick ranch, so roof, plumbing and electrical updates drive the price.

sections.h2: Who employs people in West Valley City?
sections.html:
West Valley City has a large employment base in finance, logistics and manufacturing. The city's 2017 annual financial report listed Discover Financial as the top employer at 4,200 jobs, followed by United Parcel Service at 1,320, Swift Transportation at 1,118, Select Portfolio Servicing at 987 and Hexcel at 953.

West Valley City itself employed 909, and Sutter Health and USANA Health Sciences were also on the list. Companies based in the city include Backcountry.com, Black Rifle Coffee Company, C.R. England, FranklinCovey and USANA. These figures are from 2017, so treat them as a snapshot rather than a current count.

The Maverik Center is home to the Salt Lake City Stars of the NBA G League, and the USANA Amphitheatre and the Utah Cultural Celebration Center add event traffic near Valley Fair Mall.

sections.h2: What roads and transit serve West Valley City?
sections.html:
Interstate 215, State Route 172 (5600 West) and State Route 171 (3500 South) are the main roads, and the Utah Transit Authority runs an intermodal hub in the city. West Valley Central station is on the TRAX Green Line.

The 3500 South MAX bus rapid transit line serves the area, and the Midvalley Express connects West Valley Central and 2700 West to Taylorsville and on to Murray Central station. A planned Hunter Town Center near 5600 West and 3500 South had not been built as of the source.

sections.h2: Which school district covers West Valley City?
sections.html:
West Valley City is in the Granite School District, which serves about 67,000 students across central Salt Lake County. The district lists nine high schools, and Granger High School and Hunter High School are both in West Valley City.

Granger Senior High opened in 1958 and Hunter High in 1990. Charter schools in the city include East Hollywood High School (film education), American Preparatory Academy and Monticello Academy.

As in any city, the school boundary depends on the address. The district can confirm it before you advertise the house.

sections.h2: What rental and code rules apply in West Valley City?
sections.html:
Every owner of a rental dwelling in West Valley City must hold a current West Valley City business license. An owner with several units needs only one license if they give the city a complete, current list of the units and pay the fees. When a property has more than one owner, each is jointly and severally liable for the fees and any penalties.

The city's code also sets a rental nuisance standard. More than two police calls for one rental unit in 12 months counts as excessive calls, and an unresolved notice of violation is one with no recorded notice of compliance. The city's ordinance enforcement division handles abatement of unsightly or hazardous property and rental licensing.

  • Check that your rental license is current before listing.
  • Clear any open notice of violation and record the notice of compliance.
  • Gather the unit list if you own more than one rental in the city.

sections.h2: How do property tax and recording work for a West Valley City sale?
sections.html:
Salt Lake County property tax is due November 30, and unpaid taxes become delinquent on December 1. Notices are mailed by November 1, and the 45-day appeal window runs from August 1 to September 15. Properties more than five years delinquent go to a tax sale in late May.

A primary residence in Utah is taxed on 55% of its market value because of the 45% exemption. A second residence or an unoccupied house is taxed at the full value.

Deeds are recorded at the Salt Lake County Recorder, 2001 South State Street, Suite N1-600. The flat fee is $40.00, the deed should list the parcel number and the grantee's mailing address, and it needs a notary acknowledgment. The same office keeps the ownership records the city code uses to identify an owner.

sections.h2: What should a West Valley City seller expect?
sections.html:
The weather is the same as elsewhere in the valley, with average highs of 94.0 degrees in July and 38.6 in January at Salt Lake City, about 15.5 inches of precipitation and strong winter inversions which puts steady wear on roofs and heating and cooling systems.

West Valley City sellers can list, sell on their own or ask for a cash offer. Cash Home Buyers buys houses here in their present condition, including older ranch houses that need updates. You can request an offer, look over how it was built and decide for yourself.

faqs.q: What county is West Valley City in?
faqs.a: West Valley City is in Salt Lake County. Property tax, valuation appeals and deed recording go through county offices in Salt Lake City.

faqs.q: When are property taxes due in West Valley City?
faqs.a: Salt Lake County property tax is due November 30, and delinquency starts December 1. Notices are mailed by November 1.

faqs.q: Do I need a business license to rent out a house in West Valley City?
faqs.a: Yes. Owners of rental dwelling units must hold a current West Valley City business license, and multi-unit owners can use one license with a list of units.

faqs.q: Which school district serves West Valley City?
faqs.a: The Granite School District. Granger High School and Hunter High School are in the city.

faqs.q: Can I sell a West Valley City house that needs work?
faqs.a: Yes. You can sell a house as-is, and many owners of older ranch houses use a cash sale to avoid paying for repairs before closing.
